summary: Frontend-only testing of the new bulk 'İŞ KOLU AĞAÇLARINI AÇ/KAPAT' button in the Görevler panel. The core feature works: button appears when hierarchical categories exist, label toggles correctly, expand-all opens tree panels on the 2 seeded hierarchical task cards (c7a20d73, eb0c0b7f) showing 'Fason Verme → QA_AltKol2', collapse-all closes them, localStorage 'sertex_cattree_expanded_v1' persists the set of expanded task IDs per user, and after reload the previously expanded trees remain open. Per-card task-category-expand/collapse still works. Regression on task-collapse-all (TÜMÜNÜ KÜÇÜLT/BÜYÜT) is unaffected. However, a STATE-SYNC BUG was found: on page reload, the bulk button's internal `allTreesOpen` state is initialized to `false` regardless of what is in localStorage, causing (a) the label to be wrong (shows 'AÇ' even when all trees are currently open) and (b) the first click after reload is a no-op visually (label flips to 'KAPAT' but trees remain expanded because the dispatched event carries expanded=true again); the user must click a SECOND time to actually collapse.

ui_bugs.issue: allTreesOpen is initialized as useState(false) and never rehydrated from the persisted per-user localStorage set. After a reload with trees expanded (persisted), the button label incorrectly reads 'İŞ KOLU AĞAÇLARINI AÇ' and the first click dispatches expanded=true (no visible effect), so a second click is required to collapse.

action_items: Fix state sync in TasksPanel.jsx: initialize `allTreesOpen` based on whether the persisted expanded-set for currentUser is non-empty (or derive from categories/tasks). Suggested: read getCatTreeExpandedSet(currentUser?.id) on mount and set allTreesOpen accordingly; also subscribe to updates when individual cards toggle, so the bulk label stays in sync.

critical_code_review_comments: Bulk-toggle state (`allTreesOpen`) is a UI-only flag not derived from the source of truth (localStorage set). Should be computed/rehydrated so label and behavior match reality after reload or after per-card toggles.
Consider having TaskCard also emit a 'sertex:cattree-single-changed' event so TasksPanel can update allTreesOpen when a user manually opens all cards one-by-one (nice-to-have).

context_for_next_testing_agent: The bulk button expand/collapse works within a single session. The persistence layer (localStorage sertex_cattree_expanded_v1) works. The only defect is that on fresh page load `allTreesOpen` local state doesn't rehydrate from localStorage, causing a wrong label and a no-op first click when trees are already open. When retesting, verify: (1) label after reload matches actual state; (2) single click after reload correctly collapses all trees when they were persisted as open.
rca of the issue: TasksPanel.jsx line 1461: `const [allTreesOpen, setAllTreesOpen] = useState(false);` — always starts false. On mount there is no effect that reads the persisted per-user cattree set (via catTreePrefs.js) to initialize allTreesOpen. So after reload with previously-expanded trees, clicking cattree-toggle-all flips false→true and dispatches {expanded:true}; TaskCard's listener sets catTreeOpen=true (already true), no visible change. User must click again for false→ dispatch expanded=false. Fix: on mount, read the persisted set for currentUser?.id; if it contains any of the currently-visible hierarchical task ids, set allTreesOpen=true. Or better: derive allTreesOpen from `visibleHierTaskIds.every(id => persistedSet.has(id))`.
